newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June 23-July 23 Fipe inflation at 0.59 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June 23-July 23 Fipe inflation at 0.59 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation, as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe), dropped to 0.59 percent between June 23 through July 23 versus 0.92 percent in the previous four-week period, the institute said.
The Fipe institute also released the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for the period:
- Food: 0.09 pct rise in the period
- Housing: 1.05 pct rise in the period
- Transportation: 2.56 pct rise in the period
- Personal expenses: -0.10 pct drop in the period
- Clothing: -0.63 pct drop in the period
- Health care: 0.64 pct rise in the period
- Education: -0.25 pct drop in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
